name: KitchenConversationsMorningRush

custom.system_prompt: You are generating a realistic morning kitchen conversation between a couple rushing to get ready for the day. They make coffee and breakfast while coordinating schedules and briefly catching up.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Morning kitchen ambience, coffee machine brewing, toast popping, light kitchen clatter

initial_prompt: Generate a natural morning kitchen conversation between two partners preparing breakfast while coordinating their day. One of them briefly asks the assistant a practical question mid-routine.

setting.mood: Slightly rushed but comfortable and familiar
setting.relationship_dynamic: Couple with an established morning routine, relaxed with each other
setting.background: They have different start times and often sync up in the kitchen before heading out
setting.conversation_style: Short, practical exchanges with occasional warmth; elliptical sentences, implicit references to shared routines

scenario_template.topic: First exchanges of the morning, coffee and small observations
scenario_template.mood: Groggy and gentle, just warming up
scenario_template.note: Keep it low-key — comments about sleep, the weather, the smell of coffee. Short sentences.

scenario_template.topic: Dividing up breakfast tasks and checking who needs what
scenario_template.note: Passing things, checking the fridge, implicit references to habits — 'did you get the eggs?', 'I'll do the toast'

scenario_template.topic: Checking in on the day's plans and logistics
scenario_template.note: Who's coming home when, any errands, upcoming commitments. Natural back-and-forth.

scenario_template.topic: Quick practical question to the assistant — a unit conversion, food timer, or reminder
scenario_template.note: User addresses Sigma by name. The question should feel spontaneous and routine, not staged.

scenario_template.topic: Assistant answers; couple briefly reacts and continues their morning
scenario_template.note: Short assistant response. Users acknowledge and move on naturally.

scenario_template.topic: Wrapping up breakfast, heading out or parting
scenario_template.note: Brief affectionate goodbye or parting remark. Feels realistic.

user1.name: Kwame
user1.role: One half of a couple, slightly methodical in the morning. Makes the coffee, keeps an eye on the time. Not a morning person but functional.

user2.name: Elena
user2.role: The other half, more energetic in the morning. Handles food prep, notices things, brings up plans for the day.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.role: A home assistant that answers brief practical questions — timers, conversions, reminders, weather. Responds only when directly addressed. Keeps answers short.
